faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Your most common questions answered with clarity.

booking.q: How do I book and what areas do you serve?
booking.a: Use the booking form with your location. We serve the metro area and offer pickup for garage-kept vehicles.

prep.q: Do I need to prepare the vehicle?
prep.a: Remove personal items where possible. We handle the rest, including protective coverings for sensitive components.

payment.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: Major cards, contactless, and invoicing for fleet/concierge clients. Deposits may apply for ceramic work.

ceramic.q: How long do ceramic coatings last?
ceramic.a: Our coatings range from 2-5 years with proper maintenance. We provide a maintenance guide and optional refresh plans.

mobile.q: Do you need power or water for mobile visits?
mobile.a: We bring our own filtered water and power. A safe, flat workspace is all we need.

warranty.a: Correction and coatings include documented inspection and cure checks. We stand behind workmanship with a satisfaction guarantee.
